name: alex01-workspace
description: Secure Living monorepo with separated frontend and backend folders.

scripts.dev: node init && npm run dev --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && DATABASE_URL="file:./Secure-Living-Backend/dev.db" npm run dev --prefix Secure-Living-Backend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend && npm run build --prefix Secure-Living-Backend
scripts.build:frontend: node init && npm run build --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend
scripts.build:backend: node init && npm run build --prefix Secure-Living-Backend
scripts.start: node init && npm run start --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend
scripts.start:frontend: node init && npm run start --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend
scripts.start:backend: node init && npm run start --prefix Secure-Living-Backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix Secure-Living-Frontend && npm run lint --prefix Secure-Living-Backend
